title: First launch with Adapty unreachable renders the bundled fallback paywall
reason: paywall.fallback_title blocked until offline-first-launch-identity: the bundled fallback cannot render on a first-ever launch: AdaptySDK-iOS 4.0.2 creates the profile on the server at activation (Sources/Adapty.swift createNewProfileOnServer retries every 100 ms until the backend answers) and identify awaits that task, so the app's identity spine never commits and loadPaywall's expected-identity gate never opens. Observed the paywall load-error state "Plans couldn't load. Please retry."; the app's own AdaptySDK_Purchaser_Info is absent and AdaptySDK_Cached_Flow holds nothing. The fallback render itself is proven by E2E-N4W, which establishes the profile with one online launch and then denies every Adapty endpoint.; paywall.fallback_plans blocked until offline-first-launch-identity: same offline-first-launch identity gate as paywall.fallback_title

B4a.screen_step_mapping.contract: semanticScreenName resolves onboarding/setup step ids to a screen plus a step prop

fixture.detail: simctl uninstall + install of the build under test

assertions.detail: every Adapty endpoint is denied and verified unreachable: api.adapty.io: addresses=['0.0.0.0'] curl_exit=7 "000curl: (7) Failed to connect to api.adapty.io port 443 after 7 ms: Couldn't connect to server" | fallback.adapty.io: addresses=['0.0.0.0'] curl_exit=7 "000curl: (7) Failed to connect to fallback.adapty.io port 443 after 7 ms: Couldn't connect to server" | configs-cdn.adapty.io: addresses=['0.0.0.0'] curl_exit=7 "000curl: (7) Failed to connect to configs-cdn.adapty.io port 443 after 3 ms: Couldn't connect to server" | api-ua.adapty.io: addresses=['0.0.0.0'] curl_exit=7 "000curl: (7) Failed to connect to api-ua.adapty.io port 443 after 1 ms: Couldn't connect to server"
the release build boots with every Adapty endpoint denied

the bundled fallback cannot render on a first-ever launch: AdaptySDK-iOS 4.0.2 creates the profile on the server at activation (Sources/Adapty.swift createNewProfileOnServer retries every 100 ms until the backend answers) and identify awaits that task, so the app's identity spine never commits and loadPaywall's expected-identity gate never opens. Observed the paywall load-error state "Plans couldn't load. Please retry."; the app's own AdaptySDK_Purchaser_Info is absent and AdaptySDK_Cached_Flow holds nothing. The fallback render itself is proven by E2E-N4W, which establishes the profile with one online launch and then denies every Adapty endpoint.
same offline-first-launch identity gate as paywall.fallback_title

the denial still holds after the walk: api.adapty.io: addresses=['0.0.0.0'] curl_exit=7 "000curl: (7) Failed to connect to api.adapty.io port 443 after 2 ms: Couldn't connect to server" | fallback.adapty.io: addresses=['0.0.0.0'] curl_exit=7 "000curl: (7) Failed to connect to fallback.adapty.io port 443 after 18 ms: Couldn't connect to server" | configs-cdn.adapty.io: addresses=['0.0.0.0'] curl_exit=7 "000curl: (7) Failed to connect to configs-cdn.adapty.io port 443 after 2 ms: Couldn't connect to server" | api-ua.adapty.io: addresses=['0.0.0.0'] curl_exit=7 "000curl: (7) Failed to connect to api-ua.adapty.io port 443 after 3 ms: Couldn't connect to server"
/etc/hosts is byte-identical to its pre-run state (sha256 c7dd0e2ed261)
